identity.name: Ponte Vecchio
identity.notes: Gated 55+ single-family neighborhood in Boynton Beach, FL (ZIP 33472), west of Jog Road. 647 Mediterranean-style homes built 2000–2003 by Ansca Homes and Levitt & Sons; resale only, price range mid $500ks–low $600ks. HOA established 03/12/1999 with an elected board. Features a staffed gate, renovated clubhouse, 24-hour fitness center, resort-sized pool and spa, and a new $1M sports complex (6 pickleball courts, 3 tennis courts, 2 bocce lanes, putting green and driving range) opened July 10, 2026.

fees.note: HOA dues range $233–$677/month depending on home/lot (per 55places.com listing); exact amount for a specific home not stated. Association established 03/12/1999 (per florida-hoa.com); no CDD assessments mentioned in sources reviewed.

Public listing example; exact amount varies by home/phase (other listing examples: $615, $623, $677/month). Verify with HOA/FirstService estoppel for the specific home. Dues reportedly cover landscaping, maintenance, management, clubhouse amenities, security, common-area electricity; one listing also includes exterior painting and roof/landscape cleaning. A capital contribution equal to 3 months of HOA dues is due at closing per one Redfin listing; another listing references a $3,738 capital contribution and $300 application fee with buyer approval and no leasing for first two years (one-time/closing costs, not recurring). No CDD special assessment found in sources read. Source is a realtor blog citing public listings (not official HOA). Retrieved 2026-07-09T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.6.
Conflicting figure: 'HOA dues are approx. $475 per month' per real-ativity.com community page. Retrieved 2026-07-09T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.5.

Median household income $101,959; per capita income $64,955; median home value $446,200; 8,023 households, avg size 2.32. Retrieved 2026-07-09T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.6 (aggregator citing ACS). Median age not found on page read; community-level (not ZIP-level) demographics not available within budget. Note: ZIP 33472 covers a much larger area than the 647-home Ponte Vecchio community itself (a 55+ community, so its resident age profile would skew older than the ZIP median).
